A [[Unidentified star system (Outer Rim)|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] played host to a brief '''skirmish''' in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]] ''[[Ralroost]]'' arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] after receiving reports of mysterious [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and dispatched the [[T-65A3 X-wing starfighter]]s of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to investigate the system's [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]]. The Rogues encountered the forces of the [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Urias Xhaxin]], whose [[Ugly/Legends|ugly]] fighters had severely depleted [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], [[Hull/Legends|hulls]], and [[Laser/Legends|lasers]]. After a few shots were fired, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gavin Darklighter]] of Rogue Squadron convinced Xhaxin to surrender, and the privateer was more than willing to oblige. Aboard the ''Ralroost'', [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] discovered that Xhaxin had earlier [[Skirmish in the Outer Rim|battled]] with the mysterious ships, known as [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]], and pumped him for information. The Rogues later [[Third skirmish in the Outer Rim|journeyed]] to the point in deep space where Xhaxin's earlier battle had taken place.
